args.title: Juniper Freight Pricing Summary (main + companion)
args.body:
Combined summary of https://blog.juniper.example/2026/freight and its subscriber companion (https://insights.juniper.example/freight/companion, accessed with team code SUB-9007):

- Spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter, while contract rates held steady.
- Fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices rather than fixed schedules.
- Per the companion piece, shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.
